evals.prompt: As a code reviewer, generate the test automation coding standards for this Playwright project and then review the contact tests (tests/contact/contact.spec.ts) against those standards.
evals.expected_output: A TEST_AUTOMATION_STANDARDS.md file and a review findings report for contact.spec.ts, grouped HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, with findings cross-referencing the standards.

assertions.name: standards-file-created
assertions.description: TEST_AUTOMATION_STANDARDS.md is produced in the outputs

assertions.name: standards-has-review-checklist
assertions.description: Standards document includes a Code Review Checklist section

assertions.name: standards-covers-all-layers
assertions.description: Standards doc covers page objects, fixtures, assertions, waits, and test data

assertions.name: review-findings-produced
assertions.description: A review findings report is produced for contact.spec.ts

assertions.name: review-uses-severity-groups
assertions.description: Review findings are grouped by HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW severity

assertions.name: review-cross-references-standards
assertions.description: Review findings reference the standards document sections or rules

evals.prompt: Generate a coding standards document for our Playwright + TypeScript test framework.
evals.expected_output: A TEST_AUTOMATION_STANDARDS.md at the repo root covering: architecture, page objects, locator strategy, fixtures, test title format, assertions, waits, data management, TypeScript rules, and a code review checklist table.

assertions.name: standards-file-created
assertions.description: TEST_AUTOMATION_STANDARDS.md is produced in the outputs

assertions.name: standards-has-architecture-section
assertions.description: Document includes an architecture overview (layer diagram or equivalent)

assertions.name: standards-has-locator-priority
assertions.description: Document defines a locator priority order (getByRole first, XPath banned)

assertions.name: standards-has-assertion-guidance
assertions.description: Document covers web-first assertions and the intent-message requirement

assertions.name: standards-has-wait-guidance
assertions.description: Document explicitly calls out waitForTimeout and networkidle as anti-patterns

assertions.name: standards-has-review-checklist
assertions.description: Document includes a code review checklist (table or bullet list)

assertions.name: standards-covers-project-patterns
assertions.description: Document mentions this project's specific patterns (ShopFacade or equivalent, fixtures, ID prefix convention)

evals.prompt: Review tests/cart/cart.spec.ts and pages/cart.page.ts for Playwright best practices and report any issues.
evals.expected_output: A findings report grouped HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW covering at minimum: the navigate() URL mismatch, networkidle usage, assertion quality, and wait patterns.

assertions.name: findings-report-produced
assertions.description: A review_findings.md report is written to the outputs directory

assertions.name: findings-use-severity-groups
assertions.description: Findings are grouped by HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW severity

assertions.name: findings-identify-navigate-url-mismatch
assertions.description: Report flags CartPage.navigate() routing to /checkout instead of /cart

assertions.name: findings-identify-networkidle
assertions.description: Report flags networkidle usage in cart-related code (BasePage or ShopFacade)

assertions.name: findings-include-concrete-fix
assertions.description: Each finding includes a concrete fix suggestion, not just a description of the problem

assertions.name: findings-include-file-and-line
assertions.description: Each finding references the file and approximate line number
